name: encoding-hex
algorithm: Hex (RFC 4648 base 16, lower case) of n splitmix64 bytes, rounds times: encode, then decode back, each language's standard codec; the checksum adds per round the text length, the decoded length and one decoded byte at a moving index (README.md).

skip.c: no hex codec in C's standard library
skip.rust: no hex codec in Rust's std (hex is a crate; no crate stands in)
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; the task has no other arithmetic to wrap

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries; the round trip is tested by the lane's Go tests (TestStdEncoding_Hex, TestStdEncoding_VectorSteps)
notes: Mk: HexEncode and HexDecode into an arena reset each round (allocations of Mk's API, counted against Mk); both take the 16-byte vector path past 32 bytes. Go: encoding/hex Encode and Decode into buffers made once. Zig: std.fmt.bufPrint with {x} and std.fmt.hexToBytes into buffers made once.
Checksums agree among Go, Mk and Zig at the quick size on the owner's machine (std-encoding session 1, 2026-11-12); the publish checksum is Go's.
Not published: no number here is a measurement.
